Name: Better 10 Hearts
Author: Sonozuki
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000][size=5]ABANDONED[/size][/color][/b]

This mod adds a few perks to NPCs. 

[size=5]Perks[/size]
If it's an NPCs birthday and they have 10 hearts you will have max luck for that day
If you speak to an NPC that you have 10 hearts with you get stamina (Default 20) and if you speak to your spouse you get more stamina (Default 40) - Both are configurable. You can configure whether you want this perk with only 10 hearts or all heart levels
If you pass out in someone's house they will take you home for free with a nice letter. This applies for both inside and outside

If you have improvements for the mail please message me on discord (Satozaki#0511) with the edited line and I may push it to the mod (I'm not good at writing mail)

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*]NPCStaminaIncrease: The amount of stamina you will gain when talking to an NPC with 10 hearts
[*]SpouseStaminaIncrease: The amount of stamina you gain when talking to your spouse
[*]OnlyGetStaminaAt10Hearts: Option to decide whether you can get stamina from NPCs with or without 10 hearts (true by default)
[*]MaxLuckOnNPCBirthdays: Whether you should get max luck on NPC birthdays.
[/list]
[size=5]Extra info[/size][list]
[*]To uninstall delete Stardew Valley/Mods/Better10Hearts.
[/list]
